title: YMSG: Update Dissector with reversed Commands, Statuses and Content Fields
description:
As I've started recently reversing some latest versions of the protocol (15 and 16), I've extracted some enums from the official Y!M client `DLL`s, more specifically the Commands enum (previously thought of as Services), Command/Message statuses and Content Fields. There are more but I still have to figure out if they are useful in the context of packet dissection.

I know this protocol isn't used anymore, but I still think this MR is useful, for archival purposes at least if nothing else.

Resources:
- [Example `.pcap`](https://digitalcorpora.org/corpora/scenarios/nitroba-university-harassment-scenario/) (see `Buddy List` and `Buddy Info` packets)

 and the content swapped with the field name that
 it represents.
